execution.coverage_rule: A person is scored on the questions they actually answered; a person with fewer than half answered is excluded and counted. The rule uses observed answers only, never model output.

results.aggregation: Weighted by survey weight; each person contributes one Brier score averaged over their own questions; card shares are averaged over distinct frozen cards.

attribute_baseline.comparator: conditional logit on displayed product attributes only
